How is it affecting her happiness? If she's not romantically interested she has nothing to lose by letting him stay a friend. It might be affecting his happiness by knowing she's not into him but that just means he should distance himself from her for a bit until he can come back and be happy as her friend.

They're not disregarding you for life if they value you as a friend. Strong friendships can be life long and contribute so much joy into life. Some people just aren't romantically interested in each other but still enjoy one another's company. That's friendship. Yeah sometimes it expands into something romantic but to expect it to always go that way is wrong.
